items.text: Failures remain failures and diagnostics preserve source.
Regression fixtures reproduce real runner failures without real Cargo.
Canonical venue workflow consumes explicitly declared legs.
Pinned baseline Clippy failures are repaired explicitly without bypasses.
Prompt refresh fixture deliberately establishes a changed timestamp without timing sleeps.
Account-catalog recovery fixture separates successful default-timed setup from the unchanged deliberate abort-lock failure.
Every Norn venue leg refuses dirty source and moved HEAD before/after execution, preserves command failure, and records explicit source-witness limits.
Local prerequisites fail observably; live API smoke is explicit, compiled/linted normally and separately receipted when run.
